expectation: Cytoplasmic, fibrous signal in smooth muscle, myofibroblasts and pericytes. It should form rings around vessels and elongated strands and bundles in the stroma, sparing tumour nests and lymphoid areas. Common in stroma.
observed: A: vessel rings and fibrous stromal strands in most ROIs, with marker-free areas between them. B: elongated fibrous yellow bands between nuclear areas. C: stromal bands that avoid the dense nuclear regions. D: a ring of cytoplasmic fibrous signal, like a vessel wall. There is no row E.
why: In every ROI, SMA picks out vessel-wall rings and fibrous stromal bundles and leaves nuclear-dense regions dark, which is the expected pattern for smooth muscle and myofibroblasts.
notes: SMA outlines vessel rings and fibrous stromal strands across the tissue and stays off cell-dense nests. This is the expected smooth muscle and myofibroblast pattern, so the stain is real.
